---
title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta11
---

## Managed Schedule queue recovery after vendor auto-resume

This beta fixes a real custom-queue handoff failure seen with `Street2 -> Yard2` after a vendor rain delay. The mower resumed the retained Street2 task by itself, but the managed scheduler had already failed closed because retained-task ownership could no longer be proven. Street2 then reached 100% and returned to the dock, while queue slot 0 remained started-but-not-completed, so Yard2 was never dispatched.

- Recover a blocked custom-queue slot only when fresh vendor-backed activity proves that the same expected zone resumed after the ownership block.
- If same-zone adoption is missed but that started slot later receives a fresh, confirmed 100% completion in the same cycle, mark the exact queue slot completed and allow the normal scheduler to advance to the next slot.
- Keep the recovery fail-closed: unrelated/manual other-zone work is not adopted and no recovery path issues a fresh reset or mowing command.
- Preserve positional custom queues, including duplicate zone IDs.
- Gate/navigation semantics are unchanged; the fix is limited to managed Schedule ownership recovery and queue advancement.
